estimates.assumptions: 3 US cups = 720 ml; using typical canned/boxed chicken stock values (25 kcal, 1.7 g protein, 0.8 g fat per 100 ml)
1/4 tsp table salt contributes negligible macros
1/4 tsp granulated sugar = ~1 g carbohydrate yielding ~4 kcal
pinch of ground white pepper is <0.1 g and contributes negligible calories/macros
1 tsp sesame oil = 4.5 g; standard oil values (9 kcal/g)
1/3 cup = 50 g frozen green peas; standard values for cooked peas
1/3 cup = 30 g sliced fresh mushrooms (e.g., button or shiitake); standard raw values
1 tbs = 8 g cornstarch; standard values (~375 kcal/100 g)
2 tbs = 30 ml water contributes zero macros
1/4 cup = 25 g chopped spring onions/scallions; standard raw values
